notes: ACCESS: r.jina.ai (the route the prior Home-Decor pass used) is currently returning a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' 403 on every attempt, and WebFetch returns 403 as before. However direct curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome131' reached the origin unchallenged and, importantly, returns the SERVER-RENDERED listing chrome including the site's own result-count header (N products), the H1 and the breadcrumbs. Product tiles themselves are client-rendered, so no tile counting was attempted (nor needed). Plain requests worked at first then started returning DataDome 403s, so every fetch was spaced ~9-20s (robots.txt asks for Crawl-delay: 10). robots.txt checked first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive; it does Disallow /api/, so the internal catalog API was NOT used - all counts come from the rendered header, which is the brief's priority-1 source anyway. TREE: taken from the site's own embedded navigation JSON in the #urbnInitialPiniaState script (catchAll.navItem, with slug / typeCode / categoryId / childSlugs) on /house-home and /furniture, not from a search engine. The Home & Furniture gateway has 16 departments; Furniture is one of them and has 18 nav children, every one of which reports childSlugs=[] - i.e. these are the deepest nodes, confirmed again on each child page (catchAll.navItem.navigationItems empty, and the on-page 'Shop by Category' dropdown lists only siblings, no grandchildren). EXCLUDED from the Furniture department per brief section 3: 'Shop All Furniture' (894 products - fetched only as a cross-check reference, not emitted), 'Top-Rated Furniture', 'New Fall Furniture & Decor Collection' (seasonal collection) and 'In-Stock Furniture' (an EXTERNAL availability-filtered link). DUPLICATE RESOLVED: 'Outdoor Furniture' appears twice in the nav - slug 'outdoor-furniture-nav2' under the Furniture department and slug 'outdoor-furniture' under the Outdoor department. Both carry categoryId HOME-GARDEN-FURNITURE, the same canonical link and the same 200-product header, so it is emitted once using the Outdoor department's canonical slug. CROSS-DEPARTMENT FURNITURE: Bath > 'Bath Vanities' is filed by the site itself under categoryId HOME-FURNITURE-BATHROOM-VANITIES (vanity units/cabinets), so it is included as a 'Bathroom Furniture' bucket per brief section 1. OTHER DEPARTMENTS CHECKED AND REJECTED: Art & Mirrors (wall art, mirrors, wallpaper, paint, wall storage & hooks), Bath (mats, shower curtains, towels, hardware, mirrors, cleaning), Bedding (all textiles), Candles & Home Fragrance, Decor & Pillows (curtains, throws, pillows, vases, planters, frames, decorative objects, 'Storage & Organization' = standalone storage goods so excluded per the storage-vs-furniture line, hardware, books, botanicals), Kitchen & Dining (all tableware/cookware), Lighting (all excluded), Outdoor (only Outdoor Furniture qualifies; entertaining, planters, pillows, beach gear, rugs/doormats, garden & utility, fire pits all excluded), Rugs (textiles). No kids/nursery furniture department exists on this site. SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (no site-wide constant); each page's H1 and breadcrumb match the category requested (no silent parent-serving); no suspiciously capped value - the prior pass on this same site saw 1352 and 330 on other listings, so 200 on Outdoor Furniture is not a display cap; five categories (Accent Chairs, Outdoor Furniture, Desks, Bath Vanities, plus the Shop All reference) were read a second time in a separate session and returned identical numbers - no drift. No aggregation was performed; the leaf counts overlap (they sum above the 894 Shop All figure) because the same SKU is filed in several nav nodes.
